name: Mysoreoslo / YogaBrie (Brinkela Gjokai, Oslo)
reason: Mixed yoga-and-fitness studio and no usable site photo. Its listed site www.yogabrie.com (robots.txt allows us) is a Wix site, so all photos are on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request; the only image source would be the YogaBrie text logo on its small YouTube channel. The studio runs a daily Mysore programme and led classes, but sells itself as a "Yoga & Pilates studio" with as many Pilates and fitness classes (mat Pilates, mama-and-baby Pilates, a glute-toning "Bootylicious" class, prenatal and postnatal yoga). Judged closer to fitness than a yoga school; owner may revisit.
